scripts.predev: PIDS=$(lsof -ti:1420,1421 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then echo reclaiming 1420/1421: $PIDS; echo "$PIDS" | xargs -r kill -TERM 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; lsof -ti:1420,1421 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -KILL 2>/dev/null; fi; pkill -f '[b]inaries/tectonic' 2>/dev/null; true
